description: (The display reads these through the electrical resolver: solar and charger paths are adopted at once, battery 279 after its voltage has held steady for about 10 s.) A Victron boat: battery 279, solar 288, charger 276, inverter 275 on shore power, alternator 0. Solar ramps 0-300 W over 60 s. At 30 s the battery starts discharging (negative current, 4 h remaining). At 45 s the solar current goes null (IN and LOAD fail). At 60 s the battery is nearly flat (600 s left, 5 %), which falls in the house battery's alarm zone, so the server raises a low-charge alarm; solar current is restored. At 80 s the battery is restored (95 %).

after.note: battery nearly flat, 600 s left; solar current restored
